name: Jiangxi Special Electric Motor Co.,Ltd
summary: Jiangxi Special Electric Motor Co.,Ltd, headquartered in Yichun, China, specializes in the research, development, production, and distribution of both advanced electric motors and comprehensive lithium-ion battery energy solutions within the Chinese market. The company's diverse product range features a wide array of specialized motors engineered for various industrial applications. These include motors specifically designed for demanding sectors such as hoisting and metallurgical processes, construction, high-voltage systems, and maritime operations (for ports and marine vessels). They also provide essential motors for wind power generation, elevator systems, and environments necessitating explosion-proof safety, in addition to versatile general-purpose industrial motors. Beyond its core motor business, the company's portfolio extends to mechanical reducers and hydraulic components. Furthermore, Jiangxi Special Electric Motor Co.,Ltd is involved in the electric vehicle sector and supplies critical raw materials for lithium battery manufacturing, underscoring its broad engagement in energy-related technologies.
